Maria: heads-up — PR #9821 (kv-cache warmup tweak) is ready to merge. CI ✅, smoke passed on staging. Need 2x LGTM before 2026-03-18 21:00 PST cutoff. tagging potential approvers: @Ashok @Jules
Ashok: can take a look in ~10m, timezone permitting. if I can't, @Toni can be shadow approver.
Jules: on it now, will focus on the changelog and perf test logs.
Deploy Bot: CI checks: unit-tests ✅, e2e flaky on node-3 (re-run ok), lint ✅, images built ✅

Jules: small comment inline about a possible null check, will post suggestion.
Jules: posted suggestion, it's a one-liner; request another quick pass after I push.
Maria: pushed fix and force-pushed; PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9821
Toni: I can sign off if Jules +1 and Deploy Bot green. I'm shadow approver until 22:00 UTC.
Ashok: giving LGTM, left one nit but doesn't block.
Jules: LGTM after the fix. :thumbsup:
Maria: confirmed 2x LGTM. Merge window t-minus 25m. @Oliver can you watch rollout? If errors >3% auto-backout policy should kick in.
Oliver: watching from Canary cluster, will signal rollback if error budget exceeded.
Maria: merge command:
```bash
./scripts/merge-pr --pr 9821 --branch main --squash --run-smoke
```
Maria: after merge run: `./scripts/monitor-rollout --pr 9821 --window 15m --alert-channel eng-oncall`
Deploy Bot: merge queued, CI gate opened.
Oliver: I'll be on-call notifier; ping me in thread if you need manual abort.
Jules: thanks everyone. :rocket:
